tagline: Ask why a business number moved. Get the answer, what was ruled out, and a receipt for every claim.
track: Track 02: The Agent That Can Explain Why
target_users: FP&A / business analysts who must explain KPI changes
problem: Explaining why a KPI moved means manually querying many disconnected tables and tools, and the final answer rarely shows its evidence or what was ruled out.

components: Zetaris Lightning query engine (local Docker developer edition 2.4.3.1)
SchemaStore views (federated semantic layer: whyledger.sales_cube, returns_cube, taxi_cube)
Lightning database WHYLEDGER_MART with FILESTORE parquet materialization
zetaris.how: Zetaris federates the fragmented sources (3 retail sales channels, returns, items, customer addresses, demographics; NYC yellow taxi trips + taxi zones) into SchemaStore views, then materializes them as parquet cubes in a Lightning database. Every investigation step is one read-only SQL query on those cubes, run in parallel; each becomes a receipt (exact SQL, rows, timing, lineage) shown next to the claim it supports.

World Model.how: question -> tested -> hypothesis -> driven_by -> segment graph; every fact carries provenance with the backend and a sha-256 checksum of the query and its rows.

nvidia.how: Nemotron frames unusual questions, forms a hypothesis-ranking hunch in parallel with the SQL tests (then compared with the evidence), and narrates the answer under a citation check. Numbers never come from the model; calls are disk-cached and time-budgeted.

cursor.how: Developed in Cursor with Cursor-based coding agents directed by the team member; see docs/CURSOR.md.

pre_existing_components: Meterless H-MEM and World Model reference implementations (Apache-2.0), vendored by npm run setup
TPC-DS schema / Zetaris TPCDS_DB and NY_TAXI sample data
datasets: Zetaris NY_TAXI (NYC TLC yellow taxi 2024-2025 + taxi zones)
